body: Surfaced during T-88 review (pre-existing, not introduced by T-88). Web ItemDialog stores are a single comma-joined text input (storesInput), so a store named e.g. "Costco, Inc" splits into two stores on save and cannot round-trip. Post-T-88 this also makes the stores field read as changed on an otherwise-untouched save, re-stamping only that field (harmless to other fields; does not defeat the merge goal). Android stores are a chip list and are unaffected. Fix: use a real multi-value editor (chips) like Android, or escape/scope the separator. Files: web/src/components/ItemDialog.tsx (+ test).
title: Web: a store name containing a comma does not round-trip the stores text input
